title: Reproducible Research in R for CRFS
description: A practical, workflow-focused introduction to R for researchers and students who want to conduct and communicate reproducible research, treating reproducibility as a default practice rather than an advanced topic. Requires no prior programming experience. This variant is adapted for CRFS: the examples and context have been changed to fit CRFS work in Africa and the Sahel.
authors: Original by Christian Martinez; this variant is for CRFS
